variants.hypothesis: At the 300m kernel radius, a 2.8px spacing lock (just inside the kernel) still prevents 1.0px densification that forfeits 0.04-0.07 TP/dot, while opening ~15% more candidates than 3.5px; should sit slightly below p3space35 (+0.007) but above densified R1 (+0.005).

A 350m collar removes ~30% more collar dots than 300m; if the collar is net-negative (potential-field side-lobes) the extra removal adds credit, but if it cuts real relay splays the spacing lock limits loss; predicted intermediate between p3space35 (+0.007) and p4space35 (+0.002).

400m equals GeoDAWN line spacing; if prior p3.7/p4.3 decline was densification-driven, a 2.8px lock should recover to break-even; if it was tip-loss it remains negative. Tightest spacing tests whether 2.8px is sufficient to keep refills non-redundant at larger collar.
